support_spans: left posterior auricular scalp lesion
MART-1: Highlighted normal melanocytes in basal layer of epidermis only

candidates.name: Recurrent Melanoma
support_spans: new and progressive satellite lesions while undergoing pembrolizumab therapy
Multiple satellite lesions were present on the left posterior auricular scalp area
candidates.why: The patient's history of multiple satellite lesions and local progression despite treatment suggests recurrent disease.

candidates.name: Inflammatory Melanoma
support_spans: intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous neutrophils, histiocytes, eosinophils, and lymphocytes
candidates.why: The presence of a mixed inflammatory infiltrate in the dermis supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Melanoma
support_spans: Incidentally resected lymph node showed focal involvement
MART-1 immunostain confirms complete tumor regression
candidates.why: The patient's history of a scalp lesion and lymph node involvement, along with the presence of melanocytes and tumor regression, support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Dermatofibroma
contradict_spans: intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous neutrophils, histiocytes, eosinophils, and lymphocytes
candidates.why: The presence of a mixed inflammatory infiltrate could suggest an alternative diagnosis, but the overall clinical and histopathological picture is more consistent with melanoma.

candidates.name: Inflammatory Hypertrophy
contradict_spans: H&E sections showed intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate
candidates.why: The intense inflammatory infiltrate could be seen in inflammatory hypertrophy, but the clinical context and presence of melanoma markers make this diagnosis less likely.

unexplained_specific_evidence: H&E sections showed intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate

selector.rationale: Evidence of melanocytes and recurrent lesions on the scalp, supported by MART-1 immunostain and histopathologic findings

rejected.label: Dermatofibroma
rejected.why: Lack of support and presence of intense inflammatory infiltrate

rejected.label: Inflammatory Hypertrophy
rejected.why: Lack of support and presence of intense inflammatory infiltrate
